text:
Maria G.: Heads-up — starting a small project to declutter the inference control-plane surface and create an explicit ownership/tech-debt amortization map. Goal: fewer cross-service touchpoints, clearer rollback lanes, and incremental debt paydown. Looking for quick alignment.

Kevin L.: +1. Can you call out what "small" means here? number of services, timeline, and perf risk. :eyes:

Maria G.: Good q. Rough sketch: 1) pick 6 candidate endpoints that see the most divergent callers, 2) collapse/redirect 3 of them to a thin facade, 3) split one stateful responsibility into a sidecar, 4) backlog the rest as low-priority tech-debt tickets. Target: 8-week window with two 2-week canaries.

Sara T.: Sounds reasonable. Danger is batch/kv cache ownership — we've had subtle latency regressions when we moved that ownership last time. Need perf guards.

Alex P.: Agree with Sara. Also want clear migration primitives: feature flags + routing rule + fast rollback. If we can treat each candidate as a small deployable with a toggle, we can do canary -> ramp -> rollback easily.

Maria G.: Exactly. Proposed primitives: (a) routing config in control-plane (feature-flagged by tenant), (b) an observability checklist per candidate: p50/p95, error rate by route, token-cost delta, and correctness sniffers (saved prompts). Quick sketch:

```
# migration plan example
- candidate: inference/transform-enrich
  - facade: transform-enrich-proxy (thin shim)
  - fallback: original-service
  - flags: enroll=off/on, canary=10/50/100
  - metrics: p50,p95,err,token-cost,eval-regression
  - rollback: instant route revert + token-cache flush
```

Kevin L.: Perfect. Can we add a gated perf test before canary? e.g., run a short synthetic load with stored prompt set and assert delta < 10% p95. Otherwise no canary.

Maria G.: Yes. Gate rules: perf gate (synthetic) AND smoke test (end-to-end golden prompts) must pass. Ops-bot will capture canary alerts.

ops-bot: note: created ticket INF-4123 and scheduled a canary slot next Tue 03:00 UTC. See <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4123>

Sara T.: Also please add an ownership doc (single line owner + escalation) for each facade. Lack of clear oncall led to slow rollbacks in prior cutovers.

Alex P.: One more: let's tranche the debt paydown into 3 buckets: quick wins (2 dev days), medium (1 sprint), deep (multi-sprint). We'll attach estimates to each candidate.

Maria G.: Thanks — I'll draft the ownership map + tranche estimates today and post here. If no objections by EOD, I'll open PR for the routing config + canary checklist. :thumbsup:

Kevin L.: No objections from me.

Sara T.: LGTM.

Alex P.: LGTM.

Maria G.: Cool — will follow up with PR + a 1-hour sync for exec sign-off on Monday.
